title: Record the printed 112-port triple count
body:
## Summary
- `C(112,3)` is 227920. The braid note prints 229936, which is larger by 2016.
- The printed order histogram sums to `C(112,2) = 6216`. The printed extension counts sum to 50, and `846 + 50 = 896`. The ordered-product count `112 * 111 = 12432` matches the printed figure.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged. The route products were not enumerated.
